def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # normalize label variants
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].astype('string').str.strip().str.replace(r'\s+', ' ', regex=True).str.title()
    region_fix = {'Suoth': 'South', 'Eats': 'East', 'Nroth': 'North', 'Wset': 'West'}
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].astype('string').str.strip().replace(region_fix)
    # parse dates: try ISO first, then fall back to generic parsing
    d = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'], format='%Y-%m-%d', errors='coerce')
    mask = d.isna() & df['Date'].notna()
    if mask.any():
        d.loc[mask] = pd.to_datetime(df.loc[mask, 'Date'], errors='coerce', format='mixed')
    df['Date'] = d
    # enforce numeric rules and recompute Revenue = Quantity * Price
    df['Quantity'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Quantity'], errors='coerce')
    df['Price'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Price'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[df['Quantity'] < 1, 'Quantity'] = pd.NA
    df.loc[df['Price'] < 0, 'Price'] = pd.NA
    df['Revenue'] = df['Quantity'] * df['Price']
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Date', 'Revenue'])
    df['month'] = df['Date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
    g = df.groupby('month')['Revenue'].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
